wild-fire-twin.displayName: Wildfire Twin – Digital Twin Disaster Simulation
wild-fire-twin.description: Scaled a live disaster simulation to a sub-30s SLA at 1K concurrent events with a Kafka-to-Spark pipeline. Cut P95 spatial-join latency by 91% across 11.5M building footprints by rewriting Python UDFs to Apache Sedona, and powered a live Streamlit dashboard by indexing geospatial data with Uber's H3 and DuckDB.

TexMex.displayName: TexMex – Live LaTeX Editor for VS Code
TexMex.description: Enabled real-time distributed editing for 1,200+ users by scaling a zero-dependency LaTeX extension and architecting a fault-tolerant WebSocket server for instant state synchronization. Achieved sub-100ms latency on 10K+ line documents by embedding pdf.js and optimizing the TypeScript event loop.

Private-Credit-Portfolio-Engine.description: Built REST microservices for managing credit facilities, borrowers, and covenants with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Flyway-managed schema migrations. Secured every endpoint with stateless OAuth2/JWT authentication via Spring Security, and ensured business-logic correctness with a layered JUnit 5 & Mockito unit suite plus a Cucumber integration suite wired into CI/CD.

Gubernator---Distributed-API-Rate-limite.description: Secured high-traffic endpoints processing 100K+ requests per second with a distributed Go-based architecture. Cut API abuse by 99% with a highly concurrent Token Bucket algorithm, and sustained sub-millisecond latency by optimizing dual-protocol payload routing for both gRPC and REST.
